title: Supply of Battery Charger for various Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate
summary: E-tender for supplying battery chargers to various lighthouses under the Chennai Directorate, open to OEMs, authorised dealers, licensed contractors and government undertakings.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

scope.item: Supply of Battery Charger for various Lighthouses under Chennai Directorate (quantities not given in this notice)

money.notes: EMD by FDR/DD and non-refundable tender fee by DD in favour of Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; originals by 02.05.2024 15:00. Small Scale Industries with valid NSIC certificate exempt from tender fee and EMD.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Reputed Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) or authorized dealers of OEMs, licensed contractors, parties or Government Undertakings
notes: Section I NIT only; no specifications, quantities or list of lighthouses. Bid download/submission 17.04.2024 17:00 to 02.05.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 03.05.2024 15:00.
